observations.clean_workflow: draft -> authorized human approval -> separately recorded synthetic source match -> active claim -> permit -> revocation recorded -> subsequent request denied
observations.revocation_transition: revocation changes claim status but does not fabricate an application decision; a distinct subsequent request produces TOKEN_REVOKED
observations.ambiguous_workflow: AMBIGUOUS_DATE visibly requires review and cannot request a claim
observations.correction_workflow: human correction visibly changes 2828-04-15 to 2028-04-15 while stating that the original AI draft is preserved
observations.non_color_cues: status names, reason codes, gate labels, and timeline text accompany visual color

limitations: This is a static interaction prototype, not a deployed production service.
Browser QA does not establish WCAG conformance or usability with caregivers.
The browser surface simulates the deterministic outcomes tested in Python; it does not call the Bedrock model or live registries.
